scope: Additive Royal Champion Hog Rider Puppet L1-18, active invisibility and spawned Hog Rider audit.
game_version: Official February 2024 release and January 2026 balance; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: February 2024 Update - Patch Notes
facts: Royal Champion Equipment unlocked at Blacksmith level 7 summons a team of Hog Riders.
sources.limitations: No summon count, spawned level, invisibility, placement, combat order or child-stat inheritance is given.

sources.title: January Balance Changes!
facts: Spawned Hog Rider level increased by 9.09-25% and number of Hog Riders increased by 11.11-14.29% at Equipment L1-7.
sources.limitations: The article gives percentage ranges but no exact old/new value for any individual level; exact current L1-7 count and child level cannot be reconstructed safely.

sources.title: What is Hero Equipment?
sources.version: Current overview; no client build stated
facts: The Equipment overview lists summoned-unit count and level, Champion invisibility, Champion health recovery and HP increase.
sources.limitations: No numeric invisibility duration, count, child level or event ordering is tabulated.

sources.title: Hog Rider Puppet — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table matches pinned L1-18 Champion HP increase 60-570 and ore costs.
sources.limitations: Does not list current summon counts, child levels, invisibility or recovery.

sources.title: Hog Rider — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Ordinary Hog Rider has 15 levels and is a ground, Defense-priority unit that crosses Walls.
sources.limitations: Does not prove Equipment children share every ordinary troop statistic, placement, attack phase or modifiers.

sources.title: Pinned Hog Rider Puppet Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned summon counts are 8-10, child levels 5-12, Champion invisibility 1 second, HP bonus 60-570 and recovery 180-1000.
sources.limitations: The January 2026 L1-7 buff makes pinned count/level continuity uncertain; no child spawn or invisibility tick order is supplied.

derivations.result: Retain pinned count/child-level series as historical catalogue values and mark L1-7 numeric continuity uncertain
derivations.method: Compare the 27 February 2024 release and pinned series with January 2026 percentage-range buffs without inventing a per-level mapping.

derivations.result: Use a distinct coverage row and keep ordinary Hog Rider inheritance unverified
derivations.method: Official Equipment source establishes spawned Hog Riders, but neither it nor the dated ordinary troop table defines child spawn, modifier and collision semantics.

rejected_inferences.rule: Multiply each pinned L1-7 count and child level by the published percentage range
rejected_inferences.reason: The percentages are ranges with no per-level mapping or rounding rule, and the pinned payload's relation to the maintenance build is unverified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Spawn ordinary Hog Rider actors directly at Champion center on activation
rejected_inferences.reason: The child formation, positions, entity-ID allocation, tick and ordinary-stat inheritance are not sourced.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply one-second invisibility to spawned Hog Riders
rejected_inferences.reason: The secondary overview identifies Champion invisibility, while the pinned ability field does not name child targets.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply recovery before the Champion can die on the same tick
rejected_inferences.reason: Ability command, recovery, damage, death and simultaneous Equipment ordering are not specified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat maximum TH18 ordinary Hog Rider L15 as the Equipment child level
rejected_inferences.reason: The pinned Equipment series explicitly labels child levels 5-12, separate from army research.

items: exact current L1-7 count and child level and L8-18 continuity
current Champion invisibility and recovery values, eligible targets and duration
activation, recovery, invisibility and child spawn tick order
HP bonus stacking, max/current HP conversion, death and Phoenix interactions
Viewer controls/overlay, snapshot, replay and RL command state
ordinary Hog Rider stat inheritance, current child levels and count
spawn formation, position, collision and entity-ID order
first acquisition/attack and Wall-crossing path timing
trap, aura, spell, Pet and other Equipment interactions

conclusion: Hog Rider Puppet L1-18 and spawned Hog Riders remain partial and catalogue-only. Official notes confirm the summon and January 2026 L1-7 count/child-level buffs; exact current values, invisibility/recovery order, child placement and combat remain unresolved. No Equipment or child Core actor is enabled.
